additional_info.subject: ID0462039-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2 /S5 313659082001] White LED CRM:00315003085
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC, customer is complaining about a Modbus communication error in DC2 (Main EcoG)
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0462039
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: Vadec SA
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 /S5 313659082001
Charger ID / Serial No.:
JcsrWF
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution: Check these cables input to the main EcoG and remove and replug the XD10.3B/A sometimes this connector is a bit loose and can cause these interferences:
​​​​​​​If the problem persists after the steps above, please try replacing the EcoG.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-XX SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0462039-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2 /S5 313659082001] White LED CRM:02832000730
additional_info.body:
Good morning,
thank you very much for the confirmation.
I regret that the system is not currently running at 100% stability, but we are trying to resolve these issues as soon as possible. Our colleagues are currently analyzing why these sporadic failures are occurring. As a rule, we can get the system up and running again with a soft reboot.
We have ordered replacement parts for the charging station upstairs and expect to visit you in calendar week 3-4 2026. We will then schedule a full day to thoroughly check both chargers again and flash the software to the latest version.
Thank you for your understanding.
I would like to wish you a Merry Christmas and a successful New Year.
On behalf of Siemens E-mobility, I would like to thank you very much for the good cooperation in 2025.
Freundliche Grüsse
Alexander Müller
